notes: Pinky on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663), paired with IMD at 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127. LaunchToken (Pinky, PINKY, 18 decimals) has no constructor arguments; the factory splits its supply. PinkyStaking(stakingToken_, rewardToken_) = ($token, IMD): PINKY stakers earn the IMD that broken promises forfeit; it has no owner and no settings. PinkyVault(owner_, imd_, staking_, intake_, action_, signer_, minBond_, panelSize_, quorum_, validForSeconds_) = ($owner, IMD, PinkyStaking, the IdentityMD Intake 0x1397434cd35e8a9c8ac312a61d3a285eb31dea56 on Robinhood Chain, bytes32("oracle.request@oracle-1"), the oracle signer 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982, minimum bond 5 IMD = 5000000000000000000, panel size 7, quorum 5, answers valid for 86400 seconds). The owner comes from policy via $owner and may later change the Intake and action id (setProtocol), the signer (setSigner) and the panel settings (setPanel); IMD, PinkyStaking and the minimum bond are immutable. Constructors call no other contract. No initialization calls; no contract here receives any of the launch supply.
